    • init

      public static void init()
      Initializes the logging framework.

      This method does nothing by itself. But by calling it, execution of the static initializer is triggered.

    • getDispatcher

      public static LogDispatcher getDispatcher()
      Returns the global LogDispatcher by using the available ILogDispatcherFactory implementations loaded through ServiceLoader and connects all known loggers to it.
      Returns:
      The global LogDispatcher instance.
      Throws:
      ServiceConfigurationError - if no factories can create a LogDispatcher.

    • getLoadedPlugins

      public static Map<String,String> getLoadedPlugins()
      Retrieves a read-only view of the currently loaded plugins. The map contains plugin names as keys and their respective configurations or descriptions as values. The returned map is immutable, ensuring that the caller cannot modify its contents.
      Returns:
      an immutable map of loaded plugins, where the keys represent plugin names and the values represent their configurations or descriptions.

    • setStatusLevel

      public static void setStatusLevel(LogLevel level)
      Sets the global status logging level for the framework. This method updates the logging level that determines which log messages will be processed and displayed. Log messages with a level below the specified threshold will be ignored.
      Parameters:
      level - the logging level to be set. Must be a value from the LogLevel enumeration.

    • setStatusName

      public static void setStatusName(String name)
      Sets the global status logging name for the framework.
      Parameters:
      name - the status name to be set.

    • setStatusDest

      public static void setStatusDest(String dest)
      Sets the global status logging destination for the framework.
      Parameters:
      dest - the status destination to be set (err, out, or a file path).

    • getStatusLevel

      public static LogLevel getStatusLevel()
      Retrieves the current status level of the logging framework. The status level determines the minimum severity of log messages that should be processed or displayed by the framework. Messages with a severity lower than the status level may be ignored.
      Returns:
      the current status LogLevel of the logging framework.

    • getStatusName

      public static String getStatusName()
      Retrieves the current status name of the logging framework.
      Returns:
      the current status name.

    • getStatusDest

      public static String getStatusDest()
      Retrieves the current status destination of the logging framework.
      Returns:
      the current status destination.

    • logInternal

      public static void logInternal(LogLevel level, String msg, Object... args)
      Logs a message at the specified log level, formatting the message with optional arguments. The message will only be logged if the specified log level meets or exceeds the current logging status level.
      Parameters:
      level - the log level at which the message should be logged. Determines whether the message will be logged based on the current status level.
      msg - the message to be logged. Supports formatting placeholders similar to String.format(String, Object...).
      args - optional arguments to fill placeholders in the message string.
